bluebook-0.title: Blue Book: Robertson Panel origins & 1952 flap (Wright-Patterson)
bluebook-0.summary: Project Blue Book was the USAF study of UFOs from 1952 to 1969, headquartered at Wright-Patterson AFB. It logged 12,618 reports, of which 701 remained "unidentified".
evidence: Records transferred to the US National Archives (NARA RG 341).
bluebook-0.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

rumors.text: Hangar 18 at Wright-Patterson holds recovered alien craft.

bluebook-1.title: Blue Book: Fort Monmouth radar case
bluebook-1.summary: Army radar instructors tracked a fast target, and pilots saw a silver disc. The case helped trigger Project Grudge’s reorganization into Blue Book.

bluebook-2.title: Blue Book: Chiles-Whitted UFO encounter
bluebook-2.summary: Eastern Air Lines pilots reported a cigar-shaped craft with windows passing their DC-3. Project Sign considered it unexplained; later analysts proposed a bright meteor.

bluebook-3.title: Blue Book: Exeter incident
bluebook-3.summary: A teenager and two police officers reported a low object with red lights. Blue Book initially blamed military exercises, then changed to "unidentified".
evidence: Blue Book evaluation: Unidentified.
